description: A SessionStart(compact) hook that nudges a compacted lead to run wsflow:lead-revive before anything else, only in a project with ai-docs/WORKFLOW.md at its repository root (or, outside a repository, at the nearest ancestor holding one), and the Claude mod (claude-mod/register.ts), the one hooks module Claude Code accepts per plugin. Every mod feature but the MCP reconnect and compaction request levers is switched by a claude.* config key; this package ships conservative defaults: the compaction advisory, workflow manual injection, tool-call captions, the status band and the MCP watchdog are off, and the mailbox drain is notice, until a config tune turns them on. The compaction advisory, manual injection and drain keys are read once at session start from the project, global and built-in values; a failed or refused read leaves the feature off (the drain reads as notice), except that a failed first manual injection read is read once more when the MCP server resolves again (a later session start or a reconnect), and a true read then starts manual injection with the session key the agent already bound through the mailbox watch tool, minting one only when none is bound. Its mailbox push feature: arriving cross-session mail for the bound session key starts a turn even in an idle session, and mail arriving while a main-thread turn runs joins that turn at its next tool call's result; with claude.mailbox_drain direct the mod receives the mail itself and submits it, and with notice it submits a prompt telling the lead to receive it. Where the workflow manual injection feature owns the conversation's key the mod binds every key the conversation gets itself and registers no bind tool, and elsewhere the agent binds its key through the mod's mailbox watch tool. Its lead compaction timing feature: a compaction request tool, always available, the lead calls at a boundary of its choosing, whose continue flag, when set, submits a fixed resume prompt after the compaction unless another prompt has already started the next turn, and (claude.compaction_advisory_enabled) advisory and milestone wake turns before native auto compaction. Its MCP reconnect feature: a reconnect request tool the agent calls when the plugin's MCP server has gone, and a /mcp reconnect at the next main-thread turn end, reported to the agent on failure and followed on success by the same guarded resume prompt when its continue flag is set. Its MCP watchdog (claude.mcp_watchdog_enabled, every claude.mcp_watchdog_interval_minutes minutes): when none of the plugin's MCP server tools is listed and no turn or reconnect request step runs, the same /mcp reconnect with no model call, a success written as one transcript line with no prompt, one transcript notice per failure streak, and no further attempts after 3 failures in a row until the server is back. The watchdog keys are read once at session start like the other mod keys, but a failed, refused or invalid read takes the key's default from this package's config-manifest.json; a server that never connected in the session is reconnected, by the watchdog and the reconnect request tool alike, under the name derived from this package's plugin.json mcpServers key. Its workflow manual injection feature (claude.manual_injection_enabled, in a project with ai-docs/WORKFLOW.md at its repository root): a lead session key minted per conversation and the keyed workflow manual carried in the system prompt, workflow_manual answered with the session state alone while the prompt carries the manual, a repeated playbook_read or workflow_manual collapsed to a pointer while its earlier result is still in the conversation, and a main-thread workflow_manual call with another lead key (a revive) adopted as the conversation's key. Its playbook preload, riding on that feature's key: when one of this plugin's lead skills is expanded for the model, its preload block is replaced with the named playbook's body read with the conversation's lead session key, never the session state or the key, so the skill arrives with its procedure and no model-issued playbook_read; a playbook is one repeat unit across its preloads and main-thread playbook_read results, so while an identical body is still in the conversation a second preload replaces the block with a pointer line ahead of its fallback prose and a second read returns a pointer to that copy; lead-use-mailbox, any other plugin's or project's skill, a session with no key held, and a failed read leave the block and its fallback prose as they are. Its tool-call caption feature (claude.display_summary_enabled): a finished, collapsed tool row, or a run Claude Code folds into one group, drawn as a short caption a second model call wrote from the call and the lead conversation since its last compaction; the model still reads the raw result and the expanded view draws the raw row. Its status band feature (claude.status_band_enabled, read with the lead session key when one is held so a session-scope tune applies, and read again after each config tune call): a framed band above the prompt with the model and effort as its border title, the folder, the git branch and changes, a context usage bar, the rate-limit and cost figures, and, while the manual injection feature holds a lead session key, that session's mailbox address, todos and agenda keys, each refreshed by events rather than per redraw. Claude Code auto-discovers this file by its hooks/hooks.json path; there is no plugin.json pointer to it.
